name: COSO — Achieving Effective Internal Control over Sustainability Reporting (2023)
issuing_body: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission
changelog: Structural shell only, seeded as draft. Supplemental guidance applying the COSO 2013 components to sustainability reporting; needed for the FRC IFRS S1/S2 roadmap work but not yet researched in detail.

framework.name: COSO — Achieving Effective Internal Control over Sustainability Reporting (2023)
framework.issuing_body: Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission
framework.description: Supplemental guidance applying the COSO 2013 internal control framework to sustainability and ESG reporting.

requirements.title: Applying the five components of internal control to sustainability reporting
Scoping sustainability information and reporting boundaries
Identifying and assessing risks to reliable sustainability reporting
Designing controls over sustainability data collection and estimation
Controls over third-party and value-chain sustainability data
Monitoring and evaluating deficiencies in sustainability reporting controls
